title: Enhanced Proliferation of Human Pluripotent Stem Cells in Tryptophan-Fortified Media
author: Kameda, Someya, et al.

steps.title: Prepare TRP‑fortified mTeSR1 medium
steps.instruction: Add 53 mg L‑tryptophan (TRP) to ~50 mL of mTeSR1 basal medium (Solution A) drawn from a 500 mL bottle that contains 400 mL basal medium, keep the original bottle covered with a shading sheet (e.g., aluminum foil) to protect from light, and stir until dissolved; place the aliquot and the original bottle in a 4 °C refrigerator for up to 24 h in the dark; thaw the mTeSR1 5× supplement at 4 °C; once TRP is fully dissolved, filter the mixture through a 0.22‑µm sterile filter back into the original mTeSR1 bottle; add the thawed 5× supplement to reach the final fortified medium; store the completed TRP‑fortified mTeSR1 bottle at 4 °C and use within two weeks of opening, avoiding UV light and heat to prevent TRP and FGF2 degradation.

substeps.instruction: Measure 53 mg TRP with a clean spatula and calibrated analytical balance.
Transfer ~50 mL mTeSR1 basal medium (Solution A) into a clean tube; keep the remaining bottle covered with a shading sheet.
Add TRP to the aliquot, mix thoroughly, and keep the bottle covered to avoid light exposure.
Refrigerate the aliquot and the original bottle at 4 °C for up to 24 h in the dark until TRP fully dissolves.
Thaw the mTeSR1 5× supplement at 4 °C.
If any undissolved residues remain, keep the aliquot refrigerated until fully dissolved.
Filter the TRP‑containing solution through a 0.22‑µm sterile filter back into the original mTeSR1 bottle.
Add the thawed 5× supplement to the bottle to complete the medium.
Store the fortified medium at 4 °C; use within two weeks after opening; protect from UV and heat.

steps.title: Coat dishes with Matrigel
steps.instruction: Thaw Matrigel on ice, dilute 1 part Matrigel with 60 parts cold DMEM/F‑12 (1:60), dispense 10 mL per 10‑cm dish or 2 mL per well of a 6‑well plate, swirl to cover the surface, incubate at room temperature (~21 °C) for 1 h or overnight at 4 °C, cover with clean plastic wrap, and store coated dishes at 4 °C for up to one week, avoiding tilting; alternatively, use iMatrix‑511 diluted 50 µL in 10 mL D‑PBS(‑) before step 8c.

substeps.instruction: Thaw the required amount of Matrigel on ice.
Mix thawed Matrigel with cold DMEM/F‑12 at a 1:60 ratio.
Dispense 10 mL of the mixture into each 10‑cm dish, or 2 mL into each well of a 6‑well plate.
Gently swirl each dish/plate to ensure even coverage.
Incubate dishes at ~21 °C for 1 h, or place them in a 4 °C refrigerator overnight.
Cover dishes with clean plastic wrap (or equivalent) to prevent spillage.
Store coated dishes at 4 °C for up to 7 days; avoid tilting to prevent uneven coating.
If using iMatrix‑511, dilute 50 µL iMatrix‑511 in 10 mL D‑PBS(‑) and use this solution in place of the Matrigel mixture.

steps.title: Assess pluripotency via flow cytometry
steps.instruction: Harvest hPSCs grown to 40‑60 % confluence on 10‑cm dishes or 6‑well plates, collect 3 × 10⁶–6 × 10⁶ cells per line, wash and stain with 10 µL each of anti‑REA, anti‑SSEA4, and anti‑TRA‑1‑60 antibodies, incubate on ice in the dark for 30 min, perform two washes with 2 % FBS in PBS, resuspend in 500 µL 2 % FBS/PBS, filter through a cell‑strainer cap, and run samples on a Gallios flow cytometer, analyzing data with Kaluza or FlowJo; ensure equal cell numbers are used for TRP‑fortified and control conditions.

substeps.instruction: Prepare hPSC cultures that are 40‑60 % confluent on 10‑cm dishes or 6‑well plates.
Count cells (as described in steps 16‑21 of the original protocol) and collect 3 × 10⁶–6 × 10⁶ cells per cell line.
Transfer the cell suspension to a conical tube.
Centrifuge 3 min at 300 × g.
Aspirate supernatant and add 300 µL of 2 % FBS in PBS; resuspend gently.
Aliquot 100 µL of this suspension into three 1.5 mL microtubes (total 300 µL).
Add 10 µL of anti‑REA to tube 1, 10 µL of anti‑SSEA4 to tube 2, and 10 µL of anti‑TRA‑1‑60 to tube 3.
Incubate the tubes on ice in the dark for 30 min.
Add 1 mL 2 % FBS in PBS to each tube and centrifuge 3 min at 1 250 × g (or 5 min at 300 × g).
Aspirate supernatant and add 500 µL 2 % FBS in PBS to each tube; resuspend.
Transfer each suspension to a separate test tube by filtering through a cell‑strainer cap.
Run the filtered samples on a Gallios flow cytometer.
Analyze data using Kaluza and/or FlowJo software, comparing TRP‑fortified and conventional medium samples (same cell number per condition).
